raw_output: Answer: Nick faced challenges in balancing his academic workload with new responsibilities, such as research opportunities and a club. He was initially nervous about taking on more, recalling a past experience where he felt overwhelmed and nearly dropped a course. However, he had also made positive changes, such as switching majors and joining a club, which improved his social life. With the support of his professor and a supportive conversation, Nick was encouraged to prioritize his well-being and consider a flexible arrangement to manage his responsibilities.
